svg.title: Foundry worker — Woman
svg.desc: A fictional woman working as foundry worker, wearing a protective coat and a hard hat. Visible work cue: A tipped foundry ladle pours one continuous molten-metal stream into an open mould. The person is on the left, with the work cue on the right. Occupational headgear: a hard hat.
